vision.title: Our vision
vision.subtitle: IGNA is an environmental and technological initiative launched by a non-profit organization. Our goal is simple.

blocks.title: Environmental Protection
blocks.description: The management of plastic waste has become an increasingly urgent global issue, as it burdens nature for centuries. The pyrolysis technology used by IGNA makes it possible to extract energy and oil even from non-recyclable plastics. In this way, we address an environmental crisis while building a sustainable economic model.

blocks.title: A Thriving Opportunity
blocks.description: IGNA is not a short-term promise but a long-term creation of value. The revenue from oil produced from plastic waste continuously finances the construction of new plants, meaning each contribution fuels further growth. It is a self-sustaining cycle that provides a solid foundation for the stability and growth of the token’s value.

blocks.title: A Value-Driven Community
blocks.description: IGNA is not just a project, but a united community in which every member actively contributes to a cleaner future. As a participant, you don’t just gain potential financial returns — you become part of a global movement that creates tangible impact on the world. This community brings value to its members while driving real change in society.

valueFromWaste.subText: Plastic waste is no longer garbage — it’s value.
valueFromWaste.mainText: IGNA is an environmental project that turns waste into clean energy and builds a sustainable source of lasting value.

goal.heading: Our Goals
goal.subTitle: We produce oil from plastic waste using modern pyrolysis technology. The IGNA project ensures that our partners pay part of their waste removal fees in tokens, creating continuous demand and economic stability. This approach supports both environmental impact and sustainable value growth.
goal.highlightedText: We reinvest the revenue into building new plants.

partOfTheChange.title: „The world is facing a plastic crisis.”
partOfTheChange.description: A single PET bottle takes 450 years to decompose. Every year, more than 8 million tons of plastic end up in the ocean. Traditional recycling methods cannot process it all.

pyrolisis.title: The Pyrolysis Machine Provides the Solution
pyrolisis.subTitlte: „With IGNA’s pyrolysis plants, we recycle plastic waste. The oil produced generates revenue, which is reinvested into building new facilities. This creates a self-sustaining, circular model.”

blocks.title: Security
blocks.description: The project is backed by 40 years of experience in environmental protection and waste management.

blocks.title: Transparency
blocks.description: The foundation of IGNA’s operation is trust and accountability. Revenues and token movements are recorded in separate pools, making it clear how resources are reinvested into building new plants and stimulating trade. The waste management fees paid by our partners in tokens are also fully traceable, ensuring continuous demand for IGNA. This system creates stability while ensuring full transparency in how every contribution supports real-world impact.

blocks.title: Growth potential
blocks.description: The oil revenue continuously finances the construction of new plants – the more plants there are, the greater the revenue.
